0022600030.text: The Raptors (4-4, 5th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Bucks (1-7, 15th in the East, on a four-game losing streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup, Toronto's ninth game of the season. Toronto is 2-3 on the road and Milwaukee is 1-3 at home, and the Raptors are without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), while Scottie Barnes is day-to-day with groin soreness and is a game-time decision. Milwaukee is missing Kam Jones (out, ankle), and the teams have no 2026-27 games yet, though Toronto won the 2025-26 series 3-1 and beat Milwaukee 122-94 in their last meeting on February 22, 2026, in Milwaukee.
